definition.base: line.strike.v3 unchanged: observation, smoothing, opposite-push split, strength, timing, matching
definition.fixA: a renewal starts no earlier than its smoothed peak - (window - strengthWindow) = peak - 4, so its 6-frame window contains the peak and the frame after it
definition.fixB: when the current reference frame is followed by no lower smoothed force (only possible for an event start: touchdown or opposite-push start), it may serve as the valley, provided the new peak is >= window (6) frames after it; floor 0.8 and valley 0.5 unchanged
definition.momentRule: strength of a judged moment = strongest event (of the measure) with onset within +-6 frames of the judged frame; used for both measures
definition.U5: not included (fusing 1-frame gaps does not follow from U1)
definition.designIteration: draft 1 had fix B without the >= 6 frames condition. On the design panel it split 213 ordinary landings (force rising over 4-5 frames) into a 1-frame touchdown plus a strike: 223 new events instead of 92. The moment changes >= 0.1 were identical (89). The condition was added before the retrospective check was run. (Draft-1 classes were computed with an earlier, narrower attribution window, hence its one other.)

retrospectiveSingleFixes.fixBOnly: identical rankings to v3 on every labelled pair (47/63): alone, fix B starts the renewal right after the touchdown and its window misses the push (tools/measure/u1/retro_u1.ts --fixes=b)
